一沓合同摆到魏沐面前。

宋柯面带微笑的邀请：“魏沐。你是一个有才华的人，我觉得你有成为天王巨星的潜力，所以我给你开出了最好的条件！！”

说完话，宋柯看了看这小子的表情，还是无动于衷。

真是邪门了，我一大老板，亲自过来给你送合同，你就这个表情？

来点惊讶啊！！

老宋心里有些郁闷，但他没有表现出来。

魏沐冲他礼貌微笑，然后拿起合同翻开第一页。

《艺人经纪合同》

熟悉的封面，熟悉的味道。

上辈子不管是与经纪公司还是与MCN签约，都要签署这样一份《艺人经纪合同》

魏沐当年签约经纪公司的时候不懂事，在这上面吃了大亏。

后来痛定思痛，专门请了律师进修，现在一般合同根本唬不了他。

比如这份合同，规定的是与艺人签署全约。

全约就是经纪约和唱片约一起签。

唱片约的意思很简单，公司仅负责旗下歌手的音乐制作。

而经纪约则是负责处理歌手的其他商业活动，比如演唱会、代言等等。

一条条一项项看下来，不知不觉已经过了半个小时。

看完合同，魏沐慢慢抬起头。

宋柯笑着问：“你觉得这份合同怎么样？”

“原则上可以。”

原则上可以.....

这给老宋逗笑了。

他沉浮华语乐坛十几年，听过这句话不下五次，全部都来自甲方或者某些领导。

原则上可以等于不可以。

原则上不可以等于还有办法。

宋柯没想到能在这里听到这句话。

老狼不是说这小子挺有礼貌的？

怎么轮到他就成这样。

我特么才是甲方啊！！

“小魏啊。”

宋柯皮笑肉不笑的看着他：“我比你年长几岁，叫你一声小魏。”

“我宋柯凭着良心讲，没有哪个唱片公司能给出和我一样的条件。这些天不少公司找过你吧？他们开出的条件怎么样？”

老宋来之前就托圈子里的朋友打听过，确实有不少公司动心，但都不愿意花大力气扶持。

说白了，他们怕昙花一现。

以前不是没有这样的例子。

有的人凭借一首歌火遍大江南北。

A stack of contracts was placed in front of Wei Mu.

Song Ke invited with a smile on his face: "Wei Mu. You are a talented person. I think you have the potential to become a superstar, so I gave you the best conditions!!"

After speaking, Song Ke looked at the boy's expression and was still indifferent.

This is really weird. My big boss came here to deliver the contract to you in person, and this is how you look?

Be a little surprised!!

Lao Song was a little depressed, but he didn't show it.

Wei Mu smiled politely at him, then picked up the contract and turned to the first page.

"Artist Agency Contract"

Familiar cover, familiar taste.

In my previous life, no matter whether I signed a contract with a management company or MCN, I had to sign such an "Artist Management Contract"

Wei Mu was ignorant when he signed a contract with the agency and suffered a big loss.

Later, he learned the hard way and hired a lawyer for further training. Now ordinary contracts cannot scare him.

For example, this contract stipulates that the entire contract be signed with the artist.

A full contract is a management agreement and a record contract signed together.

The meaning of the record contract is very simple. The company is only responsible for the music production of its singers.

The agent is responsible for handling other business activities of the singer, such as concerts, endorsements, etc.

Reading through each item one by one, half an hour had passed before I knew it.

After reading the contract, Wei Mu slowly raised his head.

Song Ke smiled and asked, "What do you think of this contract?"

"In principle, yes."

In principle, you can...

This made Lao Song laugh.

He has been in the Chinese music scene for more than ten years and has heard this sentence no less than five times, all from Party A or certain leaders.

In principle, yes equals no.

In principle, it doesn't mean there is a way.

Song Ke didn't expect to hear these words here.

Didn't Lao Lang say that this guy is quite polite?

How could it be like this when it was his turn?

I am the one who is Party A!!

"Xiao Wei."

Song Kepi looked at him with a dead smile: "I'm a few years older than you, so I'll call you Xiao Wei."

"I, Song Ke, can honestly say that no record company can offer the same conditions as mine. Many companies have approached you these days, right? What are the conditions they offer?"

Before Lao Song came here, he asked his friends in the circle to inquire. Indeed, many companies were interested, but they were unwilling to spend a lot of effort to support it.

To put it bluntly, they are afraid of being short-lived.

There have been no such examples before.

Some people become popular all over the country with one song.
